basic_info.description: 1-bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 102% Area Median Income  (AMI). Maximum income for 1 person = $107,000; 2 people = $122,300; 3 people = $137,550; 4  people = $152,850, etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the  Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls,  monitoring & other restrictions. The unit will be available on a first come first served basis starting on 12/23/2024 at 8:00 AM PST. Please visit https://housing.sfgov.org/list-  ings/a0W7y000002j0QvEAI to view the listing and for application & program info. Fair Housing Opportunity.    Courtyard facing, 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo at Mission Walk in beautiful Mission Bay. Enjoy  views of the waterway and quick access to freeways and public transportation to take you within  and out of the city. Beautifully maintained and updated with stylish accents. In unit washer/dryer. Leased parking available on-site, via HOA wait list.
